micro_example.sql:
WITH
  deduplicated(value) AS (
    SELECT 7
    UNION
    SELECT 7
  ),
  duplicate_preserving(value) AS (
    SELECT 7
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 7
  )
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deduplicated) AS union_rows,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM duplicate_preserving) AS union_all_rows;
